top_signals.title: Cboe Eyes VIX Perpetual Futures in Broader Perps Push
top_signals.summary: Cboe Global Markets Inc. is looking at listing perpetual futures based on the Cboe Volatility Index, as US exchanges race to bring the highly levered instruments that dominate the crypto market to new asset classes.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: 'Shameless' Actor Noel Fisher on AI in Hollywood
top_signals.summary: Noel Fisher, actor & founder of Prototype Productions, joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss the economics of streaming and artificial intelligence's growing presence in the entertainment industry. Fisher speaks with hosts Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec on the sidelines of Bloomberg Screentime in Hollywood. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin fights for local uptrend as US bond yields drop from new 24-year highs
top_signals.summary: US bond yields fell sharply around Thursday’s Wall Street open as Bitcoin price action sought to preserve a local trend of higher lows.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Police disrupt KillSec ransomware, arrest suspected teenage leader
top_signals.summary: European police said raids against the KillSec ransomware-as-a-service operation included the arrest of a high-profile teen suspect.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: De olho nas eleições no Brasil
top_signals.summary:
De olho nas eleições: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro chegam ao primeiro turno empatados nas pesquisas. E novas sondagens saem no sábado antes da votação. Com Patricia Xavier e produção de Gisele Fernandes.
 (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Diesel crisis: UK minister holds emergency talks with US Energy Secretary
top_signals.summary: Energy secretary Miatta Fahnbulleh is holding crunch talks with her American counterpart over Donald Trump’s threat to curb diesel exports to Europe. City AM understands that Fahnbulleh is in direct contact with US energy secretary Chris Wright to discuss a US move to potentially choke off diesel exports to Europe that threatens to upend supply [...]
